notes.text: The Scandinavian Defence. Black attacks e4 on move one and takes back with the queen after 2.exd5.
White develops with tempo against the queen. Black steps back to a5, eyeing e1 and staying out of reach.

notes.path: e4 d5 exd5 Qxd5 Nc3 Qa5 d4 Nf6 Nf3
notes.text: White builds a clean centre. Black plays 5...c6 to give the queen a safe home on c7 and guard d5.

notes.path: e4 d5 exd5 Qxd5 Nc3 Qa5 d4 Nf6 Nf3 c6 Bc4
notes.text: White targets f7. Black brings the light-squared bishop outside the pawn chain with 6...Bf5 before playing ...e6.

notes.path: e4 d5 exd5 Qxd5 Nc3 Qa5 d4 Nf6 Nf3 c6 Bc4 Bf5 Bd2 e6 Nd5
notes.text: White tries a discovered attack on the queen. Black simply retreats 8...Qd8 and keeps a rock-solid position.

notes.path: e4 d5 exd5 Qxd5 Nc3 Qa5 d4 Nf6 Nf3 c6 Ne5
notes.text: White jumps into e5 to eye f7 and c4. Black calmly develops 6...Bf5 and meets g4 with ...Be6.

notes.path: e4 d5 exd5 Qxd5 Nc3 Qa5 d4 Nf6 Nf3 c6 Be2
notes.text: White develops quietly before castling. Black brings the bishop out to f5 and follows with ...e6.

notes.path: e4 d5 exd5 Qxd5 Nc3 Qa5 d4 Nf6 Bd2
notes.text: White prepares a discovered attack with Nd5 or Nb5. Black moves the queen to b6 to hit b2 and d4.

notes.path: e4 d5 exd5 Qxd5 Nc3 Qa5 b4
notes.text: The Leonhardt Gambit sacrifices a wing pawn for rapid development. Black takes 4...Qxb4 and tucks the queen safely on d6 after 5.Rb1.
White skips Nc3 so the queen is not chased at once. Black pins the f3 knight with 3...Bg4.

notes.path: e4 d5 exd5 Qxd5 Nf3 Bg4 Be2 Nc6
notes.text: Black puts pressure on d4 and prepares queenside castling. Against 5.d4, Black castles long with ...O-O-O.
White claims the centre before chasing the queen. Black immediately attacks d4 with 3...Nc6.

notes.path: e4 d5 exd5 Qxd5 d4 Nc6 Nf3
notes.text: White defends d4 with the knight. Black pins it immediately with 4...Bg4.
White pushes c4 to drive the queen away, leaving d4 weak. Black moves to a5 and plays ...c6 and ...Nf6.
White defends e4 instead of capturing. Black gains space and chases the knight with 2...d4.
The knight retreats awkwardly, blocking White's pieces. Black grabs the centre with 3...e5.
White pushes past to avoid the Scandinavian. Black strikes at the centre immediately with 2...c5, getting the c8 bishop out before ...e6.
White tries to build a French-style chain on d4. Black attacks d4 with 3...Nc6 and brings the light-squared bishop to f5 or g4.
The Blackmar-Diemer Gambit offers the e4 pawn. Black captures 2...dxe4 and develops smoothly.

notes.path: e4 d5 d4 dxe4 Nc3 Nf6 f3 exf3 Nxf3
notes.text: White sacrifices a pawn for open lines. Black develops the light-squared bishop actively to f5 before playing ...e6.
The Tennison Gambit offers e4 to lure Black forward. Black takes 2...dxe4 and guards the pawn cleanly after 3.Ng5.
White attacks e4 with the knight. Black defends e4 and develops at the same time with 3...Bf5.
